nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address set from msg.sender and changed only via acceptOwnership.
Ownable.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Pausable.paused: global stop flag gating transfer/approve/transferFrom.
balances mapping(address=>uint): token ledger, debited/credited in transfer paths and burn.
allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)): ERC20 allowance ledger.
Token name string, set in constructor to 'NEOWORLD CASH'.
Token symbol string, set in constructor to 'NASH'.
Token decimals uint8, set in constructor to 18.
Total token supply: minted in constructor, decreased by burn.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder, allowance holder and tokenFallback forwarder.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, stages newOwner (two-step ownership handoff).
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then sets owner = newOwner and clears newOwner.
pause(): onlyOwner, whenNotPaused, sets paused = true.
unpause(): onlyOwner, whenPaused, sets paused = false.
NeoWorldCash() constructor: sets metadata, mints totalSupply to msg.sender.
transfer(address,uint,bytes) ERC223 entry, whenNotPaused, dispatches to contract or address path.
transfer(address,uint) ERC20-compatible entry, whenNotPaused, uses empty data.
isContract(address): inline assembly extcodesize check on a caller-supplied address.
transferToAddress(address,uint,bytes): private balance transfer path to an EOA.
transferToContract(address,uint,bytes): private path that calls untrusted receiver.doTransfer and receiver.tokenFallback.
balanceOf(address): constant read of balances.
burn(uint): destroys caller tokens and reduces totalSupply.
bytesToUint(bytes): parses ASCII digits into a uint with raw unchecked arithmetic.
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves balances using allowance arithmetic but never checks the allowance.
allowance(address,address): constant read of allowed.
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint): onlyOwner sweep of arbitrary ERC20 via external call.
payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
ContractReceiver.doTransfer(address,uint256): external, attacker-implementable function whose return values drive the transfer.
ContractReceiver.tokenFallback(address,uint,bytes): external callback invoked on the recipient contract.
SafeMath.add(uint,uint): overflow-checked addition used for balance credits.
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint): underflow-checked subtraction used for balance and supply debits.
Unsafe external call receiver.doTransfer(msg.sender, bytesToUint(_data)) on an attacker-controlled contract before state finalization.
Unsafe external callback receiver.tokenFallback(msg.sender, price, _data) executed after balances are mutated.
Inline assembly extcodesize on a caller-supplied address; can be bypassed from a constructor.
result = result * 10 + (c - 48) uses unchecked arithmetic in bytesToUint.
External ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call to an arbitrary token contract.
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] without requiring the allowance to cover tokens.
